Definition: Cabul, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Cabul = "binding"; 1) a city on the border of Asher and located approx 10 miles (16 km) east of Akko; modern 'Kabul'; 2) a district in Galilee given by Solomon to Hiram and contemptuously called 'Cabul' by Hiram
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
